description: REQUIRES prior work24__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Run the work24 (고용24) 사업주 사전진단 for one workplace across the measured subsidy programmes and return a verdict per programme (eligible / ineligible / undetermined - undetermined is never counted as eligible). Read-only. Path A atomic - the same call the subsidy_pack diagnosis leg makes. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. For an anonymous result, keep its private recovery_receipt and send it with the original job_id or pack_run_id to xdata__job__result. It grants access to that result only, until the original file retention expires. Do not publish it. Losing it cannot be repaired by signing up. The receipt also works if the client later signs in; it does not grant access to other results. Without a receipt, results require the original account and lane. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

application_year.description: 신청연도 YYYY. Defaults to the current year.

business_management_no.description: 11-digit 고용보험 사업장관리번호. Omit to use the one saved at login.

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

programme_keys.description: Catalog programme keys (e.g. w24_b0010). Omit for every programme that has a 사전진단.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
